This project builds a chatbot connected to an AI Agent that provides retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enabling users to ask questions of their docs. The application is designed to run offline and for the Large Language Model (LLM) it uses Ollama to run small 3B param models such as `Llama 3.2 3B`, and uses `nomic-embed-text` for local offline vector embeddings.
